MOD = 998244353

def power(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    base %= mod
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
        base = (base * base) % mod
    return res

def main():
    import sys
    input_line = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    tokens = input_line.split()
    N = int(tokens[0])
    M = int(tokens[1])
    L = int(tokens[2])
    R = int(tokens[3])

    total = N * M
    total_exp = total
    base_range = R - L + 1

    if total % 2 == 1:
        result = pow(base_range, total_exp, modulus)
        print((result + MOD) % MOD)
    else:
        result = pow(base_range, total_exp, modulus)
        if (R - L) % 2 == 0:
            result += 1
        inv_two = power(2, MOD - 2, MOD)
        result = (result * inv_two) % MOD
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
